record kinds and fields: the pinned financial policy
if missing (what the code does): POLICY_NOT_PINNED: the figure cannot be assessed

record kinds and fields: the record's project_ref resolving to one project
if missing (what the code does): a record whose project cannot be told is excluded as unattributed (PROJECT_UNKNOWN_OR_AMBIGUOUS) and listed; the figure still finishes

record kinds and fields: ap_invoice amount (reconciled amount), invoice_date, cost_code_ref
if missing (what the code does): no reconciliation state: held (NO_RECONCILIATION_STATE); amount unknown: AMOUNT_UNKNOWN; date unknown: DATE_UNKNOWN; held, quarantined or disputed: excluded with its codes; after the cut-off: listed outside the period; the figure is provisional while anything is held
known limit and the entity that closes i: supplier invoices excluding GST only: labour, plant, accruals, contingency and overhead are not in the figure (LIMIT_COST; F-17): E57, E64, E42, E43

record kinds and fields: ap_invoice cost_code_ref
if missing (what the code does): an uncoded invoice is counted under "(no cost code)", with no qualification on actual cost (the cost-to-complete figure then marks that code unknown)

record kinds and fields: reconciliation lifecycle (duplicate_of)
if missing (what the code does): a duplicate delivery counts once (the survivor); the repeat is listed as ignored

record kinds and fields: credit_note against_invoice_ref, credit_date, amount
if missing (what the code does): a credit is applied only when it and its invoice are authoritative; an untrustworthy credit holds its invoice out; a credit after the cut-off is not yet applied

record kinds and fields: purchase_order amount, order_date, source_status, cost_code_ref; reconciliation state
if missing (what the code does): held, duplicate or after the cut-off: excluded; status missing: PO_STATUS_UNKNOWN; status not in the map: PO_STATUS_UNMAPPED; both excluded as unknown value
known limit and the entity that closes i: no order revision or approval state (E21); goods received but not invoiced are not known, no receipt data is read (LIMIT): E29

record kinds and fields: po_amendment purchase_order_ref, delta (reconciled amount), amendment_date, approved_change_ref
if missing (what the code does): held: treated as held; after the cut-off: excluded; no approved change reference: unapproved exposure (NO_APPROVED_CHANGE_REFERENCE); named change not approved or not found: unapproved exposure (CHANGE_NOT_APPROVED)
configuration or parameter: policy variation_status_map (missing: every linked amendment is exposure and the approval is unknown)
known limit and the entity that closes i: amendments on an order that is held, duplicate, after the cut-off or status-unknown are never examined

record kinds and fields: ap_invoice purchase_order_ref and its counted, held or credited state (via invoice_lines)
if missing (what the code does): an unresolved invoice naming the order makes the amount used unknown
configuration or parameter: policy credit_reopens_commitment (missing with credits present: unknown)
known limit and the entity that closes i: invoice amount only, no quantity or rate (F-09)

record kinds and fields: budget_line cost_code_ref, budget_cents, source_revision_label, revision_date
if missing (what the code does): no budget: unknown; labels differ: disputed (MIXED_BUDGET_REVISIONS); held lines excluded
known limit and the entity that closes i: no approver of a revision (E39)

record kinds and fields: ctc_line cost_code_ref, forecast_version, forecast_date, cost_to_complete_cents, estimate_basis_text, movement_reason_text
if missing (what the code does): NO_FORECAST_VERSION; AMBIGUOUS_LATEST_FORECAST; FORECAST_VERSION_DATES_DISAGREE; per code: NO_DECLARED_LINE, NO_BUDGET_FOR_CODE, BUDGET_EXCEEDED_BY, COST_NOT_ALLOCATED_TO_A_COST_CODE, DECLARED_LINE_HELD (each CTC_UNKNOWN); none known: NO_COST_TO_COMPLETE_INFORMATION; no codes: NO_COST_CODES; when the policy needs no declared line: FORECAST_DERIVED_FROM_BUDGET_NO_DECLARED_VERSION
known limit and the entity that closes i: no forecast owner, approval or tax/currency basis (S05 s5.1): E41

record kinds and fields: M4 revenue, actual cost to the forecast date, cost to complete, budget
if missing (what the code does): A_COMPONENT_CANNOT_BE_ASSESSED; stale or unconfigured freshness: provisional; actuals after the forecast date are not added (ACTUALS_AFTER_FORECAST_DATE_NOT_ADDED)
configuration or parameter: policy ctc_method, ffc_basis, cost_scope (each *_NOT_CONFIGURED stops it); freshness_days.forecast and .budget
known limit and the entity that closes i: inherits every limit of its components

record kinds and fields: contract original_contract_cents, approved_variations_cents (the contract record keyed by project)
if missing (what the code does): no contract: unknown; held or conflicting: excluded or disputed; the contract summary and the variation register disagreeing beyond the tolerance: both disputed
configuration or parameter: policy tax_basis and variation_status_map (each missing stops the figure); gst_rate_bps when tax_basis is inc_gst (GST_RATE_NOT_CONFIGURED); reconciliation_tolerance_cents (none = exact)
known limit and the entity that closes i: secured revenue is contract plus approved variations: no claimed or certified amounts (E13, E14)

record kinds and fields: variation raised_date, source_status, value_cents
if missing (what the code does): status not in the map: kept out and the figure is provisional; unapproved, disputed, rejected and approved-but-unpriced are separate classes, never in the figure

record kinds and fields: M4 forecast final cost and revenue, actual cost to the forecast date
if missing (what the code does): FORECAST_BASIS_CANNOT_BE_ASSESSED; FORECAST_FINAL_COST_NOT_POSITIVE; REVENUE_NOT_POSITIVE; a provisional forecast makes it provisional
known limit and the entity that closes i: cost-to-cost on the forecast final cost; inherits the forecast's limits

record kinds and fields: retention retention_held_cents, release_due_date, released_date, hold_reason_text (one ledger record per project)
if missing (what the code does): no ledger: unknown; held or conflicting: excluded or disputed; no due date: unknown; due date passed with money withheld: RELEASE_REVIEW_DUE (a review prompt)
known limit and the entity that closes i: client-side only; no retention held from trades (E76)

record kinds and fields: retention_event (recorded by a named person with role and evidence)
if missing (what the code does): a sequence breaking a rule: disputed (RETENTION_EVENTS_INCONSISTENT)
known limit and the entity that closes i: no entry screen for retention events (E77)

record kinds and fields: bank_txn (the release receipt)
if missing (what the code does): released per the ledger with no receipt: RELEASED_PER_LEDGER_CASH_RECEIPT_NOT_EVIDENCED
known limit and the entity that closes i: bank lines are not allocated to claims or invoices (E73)

record kinds and fields: security kind_text, face_value_cents, expiry_date
if missing (what the code does): held instruments are listed as exclusions; all held: the total is unknown, not zero; no instruments: unknown; expiry missing: unknown; expired: EXPIRY_REVIEW
known limit and the entity that closes i: no issuer, beneficiary, release conditions or fees (E78)

record kinds and fields: M4 retention position and its release_due_date; facility rate_bps, statement_date
if missing (what the code does): RETENTION_POSITION_CANNOT_BE_ASSESSED; NO_EXPECTED_RELEASE_DATE; EXPECTED_RELEASE_DATE_PASSED_AND_NOT_RELEASED; facility: FACILITY_RECORD_HELD, NO_FACILITY_STATEMENT, SEVERAL_FACILITIES, FACILITY_STATEMENT_AFTER_AS_OF; a proxy rate: RATE_IS_A_POLICY_PROXY_NOT_AN_EVIDENCED_FACILITY_RATE
configuration or parameter: policy carrying (CARRYING_NOT_CONFIGURED): rate_source, funded_share_bps, proxy_rate_bps, day_count_basis, eligibility, overlap; freshness_days.facility
known limit and the entity that closes i: forward cost only; no balance history; no facility fees (E74)

if missing (what the code does): always cannot be assessed: NO_CASH_MARGIN_EVIDENCE (face value is not collateral; no cash margin or fee data)
known limit and the entity that closes i: needs instrument fees and cash margin (E78)

if missing (what the code does): always cannot be assessed: NO_RECEIVABLES_DATA
known limit and the entity that closes i: needs claims, certificates and receipts (E13, E14, E15)

record kinds and fields: the base margin (recognised or forecast final, per the policy) and each listed component: retention_carrying, security_carrying, overdue_receivables
if missing (what the code does): any component that cannot be assessed stops the figure: A_DEFINED_COMPONENT_CANNOT_BE_ASSESSED (security_carrying and overdue_receivables always cannot)
known limit and the entity that closes i: no payables due dates, payroll or statutory outflows (E79, E80, E81)

record kinds and fields: M4 actual cost by cost code; M4 budget by cost code
if missing (what the code does): actual cost cannot be assessed: the rule cannot run; budget not positive: that code not assessed (BUDGET_NOT_POSITIVE)
known limit and the entity that closes i: F-17 scope; "whether the budget was revised" is named as missing evidence (E39)

record kinds and fields: M4 commitments: each amendment's delta, treatment and reason; purchase_order; the named variation
if missing (what the code does): commitments cannot be assessed (for example PO_STATUS_MAP_NOT_CONFIGURED): the rule cannot run; held amendment: not assessed; VARIATION_STATUS_MAP_NOT_CONFIGURED: not assessed
known limit and the entity that closes i: amendments on orders the commitments figure skips (held, duplicate, after the cut-off, status unknown or unmapped) are neither assessed nor reported

record kinds and fields: M4 commitments: committed amount, approved amendments, invoiced amount and overrun per order; ap_invoice linked by purchase_order_ref
if missing (what the code does): commitments cannot be assessed: the rule cannot run; held invoices listed as not assessed (the invoiced total may be higher)
known limit and the entity that closes i: amount only: invoice quantity and unit rate are not ingested (F-09): E23 lines

record kinds and fields: ctc_line cost_code_ref, cost_to_complete_cents, forecast_date, forecast_version, movement_reason_text
if missing (what the code does): held, disputed, undated or after the as-of date: not assessed
known limit and the entity that closes i: the M4 movement bridge between adopted runs is not consulted

record kinds and fields: purchase_order order_date, reconciled amount and each configured grouping key (project_ref, supplier, material_ref, cost_code_ref)
if missing (what the code does): not usable, undated or a grouping key missing: not assessed
known limit and the entity that closes i: a chain of orders spread wider than the window can be missed

record kinds and fields: records held out of M4 actual cost
if missing (what the code does): actual cost cannot be assessed: reported as a data-integrity signal

record kinds and fields: variation raised_date, source_status, value_cents, description_text
if missing (what the code does): VARIATION_STATUS_MAP_NOT_CONFIGURED: the rule cannot run; held: not assessed; status not mapped: not assessed; no value: unquantified
known limit and the entity that closes i: whether the work was done and client correspondence are named as missing evidence (E51, E10)

record kinds and fields: notice notice_type_text (in instruction_types), notice_date, linked_variation_ref, description_text
if missing (what the code does): held: not assessed; not an instruction type, undated or after the as-of date: silent
known limit and the entity that closes i: an instruction never recorded cannot be found: needs document or phone capture of instructions (E10)

record kinds and fields: M4 retention position: release_due_date, flags, withheld
if missing (what the code does): POLICY_NOT_PINNED: the rule cannot run; retention position cannot be assessed: not assessed
known limit and the entity that closes i: release conditions and whether a claim was lodged are named as missing evidence (E08, E75)

record kinds and fields: compliance supplier_ref, evidence_type_text, expiry_date; supplier supplier_name
if missing (what the code does): held: not assessed
known limit and the entity that closes i: a missing certificate is not detected: needs a required-evidence list per trade (E82, E16)

record kinds and fields: supplier_quote material_ref, unit_rate_minor_units, currency_code (AUD only), delivery_basis (delivered or ex-works), freight_per_unit_cents (ex-works), valid_until; reference: supplier_quote, or purchase_order unit_rate_cents and material_ref
if missing (what the code does): not AUD, ex-works without freight, another delivery basis, no order unit rate, held, different materials: not assessed
configuration or parameter: pairs declared comparable by a person; tolerance_bps
known limit and the entity that closes i: no unit of measure on quotes; the quantity to buy is unknown, so per unit only (E30)

record kinds and fields: plant_hire on_hire_date, off_hire_date, needed_until, rate_cents_per_day, equipment_text
if missing (what the code does): held: not assessed; no needed_until: not assessed
known limit and the entity that closes i: hire invoices are not checked; on-site confirmation is named as missing evidence (E64)

record kinds and fields: delay_event start_date, end_date, activity_ref, recorded_cause_text, holding_rate_cents_per_day
if missing (what the code does): held: not assessed; no end date or inconsistent dates: not assessed
known limit and the entity that closes i: holding cost unquantified without a counterfactual; no schedule network; calendar days only (E47 to E50)

record kinds and fields: timesheet work_date, work_package_ref, ordinary_hours, overtime_hours, rate_cents_per_hour; work_output work_package_ref, week_start (a Monday), quantity, unit_text
if missing (what the code does): held: not assessed; fewer complete weeks than baseline plus recent, weeks not consecutive, or the unit changes: not assessed; no rate: unquantified
known limit and the entity that closes i: conditions and acceptance are not verified (E63, E61)

record kinds and fields: defect raised_date, subcontractor_text, trade_text, rework_cost_cents
if missing (what the code does): held: not assessed; no subcontractor or trade: not assessed
known limit and the entity that closes i: cause and responsibility are not concluded (E68 to E72)

record kinds and fields: held records of the detection kinds
if missing (what the code does): reported as a data-integrity signal
